title: Discrete Wind Gust Model
text: Generate discrete wind gust, 1 input, 1 output, {Units} sets Units Metric; {Gust in u-axis} sets the wind gust to u -axis, {Gust in v-axis} sets the wind gust to v -axis, {Gust in w-axis} sets the wind gust to w -axis, {Gust start time (sec)}, {Gust length [dx dy dz] (m)} sets the gust length and {Gust amplitude [ug vg wg] (m/s)} sets the gust amplitude. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Units
params.values: Units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Gust in u-axis
params.values: Wind gust to u -axis on (default) | off

params.name: Gust in v-axis
params.values: Wind gust to v -axis on (default) | off

params.name: Gust in w-axis
params.values: Wind gust to w -axis on (default) | off
